summary: Novo Nordisk A/S filed a Form 6-K reporting daily transactions under its share repurchase programme, a US-equivalent issuer buyback disclosure. The programme, initiated 6 May 2026 under EU MAR safe-harbour rules, sits within a DKK 15 billion 12-month authorisation begun 4 February 2026, with up to DKK 11.2 billion for B shares through 1 February 2027. Purchases from 31 August to 4 September 2026 totalled 1,055,000 B shares at an average DKK 297.66, bringing the programme to 17,275,000 shares for DKK 5.22 billion; treasury holdings now 46,074,876 B shares, roughly 1.0% of capital. Watch execution pace against the DKK 15 billion cap and any acceleration signalling management's valuation view.
